title: Mussels in Indian Spice
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish that combines the sweetness of mussels with the warmth of Indian spices. This recipe is a great option for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper (if using) and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mussels and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to open.
Add the lemon juice and garam masala (if using) and stir to combine.
Cover the saucepan and cook for 5-7 minutes, until the mussels are cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the mussels hot, garnished with fresh cilantro (if desired).
